features.text: Commits made in GitHub's web editor are signed off by GitHub.

status.live: the repository setting web_commit_signoff_required is true (set 2026-10-21)

features.text: The publisher App answers each command comment once, and a triage command (`/accept`, `/decline`, `/duplicate`) opens a pull request adding the issue's record.

status.live: 2026-10-29: /accept P3 M4 on #693 was answered by the publisher App (community run 40806102086), which opened the record pull request #694

features.text: A record a triage command added lands like any pull request, and its issue then follows the record: adopted as its face, and closed when the record closes.
`/reproduce` runs the test a Flake report names on a hosted runner with no secrets, and posts the receipt.
`/track` turns an Ideas discussion or an objection to a decision into a tracker record.
A secret pasted into an issue is redacted by the publisher, with a comment saying why.
Issues, milestones and the project board generated from the harness's own records, with one Floor log comment per land.
The GitHub teams `triagers` and `reviewers`, applied from the role table.
